bio: Marilla might be the most powerful Nocturna alive. She took down a pair of Barons who carried the stolen crown of a Demon Lord and wings said to be cut from an Angel… then she stole both crown and wings for herself. Between those and her blessed handguns, only fools or kings try to stand in her way.
